summary: You can spend a long time staying loyal to what something could become while quietly getting less and less from what it is now.
body: You can spend a long time staying loyal to what something could become while quietly getting less and less from what it is now. When Venus squares Neptune, hope and attraction can make the potential of a relationship, opportunity, or creative dream feel more convincing than its present reality. The possibility may still be meaningful, but eventually the future cannot keep doing all the work for the present. Notice what is actually being offered now and decide how long you are willing to keep investing in what has not happened yet.
